name: token-saver
description: A practical multi-skill guide to concise AI responses and lower-noise prompts, with safeguards for meaning, accuracy, and code.

interface.longDescription: Token Saver helps users request concise, useful AI responses and reduce avoidable context in prompts, summaries, and technical material. Its focused skills cover concise response preferences, safe summarization and compression planning, and an evidence-aware token-efficiency review. It preserves negation, numbers, units, code, commands, paths, error text, uncertainty, and safety-critical detail; asks before removing information that could change a decision; and explains tradeoffs. It is an independent text-guidance plugin inspired in part by the public Caveman project (Julius Brussee), not an official Caveman product or executable port. It does not install or run Caveman, proxy model traffic, inspect agent history, count actual model tokens, guarantee savings, or change billing. Results depend on the model and task; verify important technical or safety information against its source.
defaultPrompt: Make your answer concise without losing important details.
Compress this text while preserving exact facts and constraints.
Review this prompt for avoidable token use and ambiguity.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: concise response guidance, safe text compression, and token-efficiency review with explicit meaning-preservation safeguards. Independent and non-executable; no actual token-count or savings claims.
